key.name: channel
key.summary: Channel override
key.description: Empty means use the detected channel. e.g. nixos-unstable, nixos-unstable-small, nixos-25.11

key.name: detected-channel
key.summary: Channel worked out from nixos-version (written by the extension)

key.name: autodetect-channel
key.summary: Work out the channel from nixos-version

key.name: color-system
key.summary: Icon colour when the system is behind

key.name: flake-enabled
key.summary: Check flake inputs at all
key.description: Off turns the extension into a plain channel checker.

key.name: flake-path
key.summary: Flake folder (or flake.lock file) to check inputs of
key.description: Leave empty to skip the input check. A leading ~ is expanded.

key.name: second-flake-enabled
key.summary: Also check a second flake

key.name: flake-path-2
key.summary: Second flake folder (or flake.lock file)

key.name: ignored-inputs
key.summary: Comma-separated input names to skip entirely

key.name: input-order
key.summary: Order to list inputs in
key.description: Comma-separated input names. "system" means whichever input built the running system; "*" marks where unlisted inputs go. Anything unlisted is sorted alphabetically.

key.name: muted-inputs
key.summary: Comma-separated input names that never colour the icon
key.description: Still checked and still listed, but excluded from the icon state.

key.name: hide-inputs
key.summary: Hide the flake input list in the menu
key.description: Inputs are still checked; only the list is hidden.

key.name: only-outdated
key.summary: List only inputs that are behind

key.name: sort-order
key.summary: Order of the input list

key.name: color-inputs
key.summary: Icon colour when only flake inputs are behind

key.name: update-command
key.summary: Command copied from a behind input's menu
key.description: {input} is replaced with the input's name.

key.name: show-open-folder
key.summary: Show an "Open flake folder" entry in the menu

key.name: color-reboot
key.summary: Icon colour when a reboot is needed

key.name: interval-minutes
key.summary: Minutes between checks

key.name: notify
key.summary: Send a notification when something falls behind

key.name: notify-per-episode
key.summary: Announce an input only once per spell of being behind
key.description: A failed check does not count as a return to up-to-date.

key.name: quiet-hours
key.summary: Hold notifications during a nightly window

key.name: quiet-from
key.summary: Start of the quiet window (HH:MM)

key.name: quiet-to
key.summary: End of the quiet window (HH:MM)

key.name: notify-once-daily
key.summary: At most one notification per item per day

key.name: check-reboot
key.summary: Warn when the booted kernel is older than the current system

key.name: recheck-on-network
key.summary: Re-check when the network becomes available again
key.description: Also covers waking from suspend, which looks like a reconnect.

key.name: show-last-checked
key.summary: Show the last-checked time in the menu

key.name: show-version
key.summary: Show the version number in the menu

key.name: hide-system-lines
key.summary: Leave the system lines out of the menu
key.description: Hides the status, installed and latest lines. The status line still appears when a check fails, since the error is not shown anywhere else.

key.name: hide-when-current
key.summary: Hide the panel icon while everything is up to date

key.name: cache-results
key.summary: Remember the last result between sessions

key.name: failure-backoff
key.summary: Retry a repeatedly failing input less often
